newsitem.title: USA: Jamaica seeking 16,500 to 18,000 T PL-480 rice.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica seeking 16,500 to 18,000 T PL-480 rice.

text.p: Jamaica is seeking offers to buy 16,500 to 18,000 tonnes of bulk rice under PL-480 terms in three shipments for September through December deliveries, its U.S. agent Fettig and Donalty Inc said.

Jamaica seeks three cargoes of 5,500 to 6,000 tonnes of U.S. number 5 or better long grain brown rice for delivery periods September 25/October 15, October 25/November 14, and November 25/December 15.
Offers are due no later than 1400 EDT on September 5, 1996, with awards to be made the following day.
